scores.name: Vertiv Holdings Co.

scores.key_signal: Net outflows improved significantly to $1.9B from prior quarter levels, with mutual fund flows at their best since Q4 2021, but persistent net outflows and elevated seasonal employment costs constrain the overall picture.
scores.name: Virtus Investment Partners, Inc.

scores.key_signal: ViaSat-3 Americas satellite reaching orbital position and imminent Inmarsat acquisition close signal a major capacity inflection point that could significantly expand revenue and free cash flow generation from FY2024 onward.

scores.key_signal: Bristow is in early innings of a multi-year offshore energy services growth cycle with multiple new contracts commencing through 2023, driving an expected significantly higher EBITDA run rate by year-end despite current seasonal and transition headwinds.

scores.name: Ventas, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Viatris reaffirmed 2023 guidance after beating Q1 expectations with $3.73B revenue and $923M free cash flow, signaling stable demand for generic and branded pharmaceuticals across developed markets.
scores.name: Viatris, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Valvoline's 13.5% same-store sales growth and 25.5% adjusted EBITDA increase signal strong consumer demand resilience for automotive maintenance services, with continued pricing power and unit expansion supporting sustained top-line momentum.
scores.name: Valvoline, Inc.

scores.key_signal: NCR delivered 4% constant-currency revenue growth (7% excluding subscription transition headwinds) with 19% adjusted EBITDA growth and strong free cash flow generation, signaling solid demand across retail, hospitality, and digital banking segments despite a cybersecurity incident.

scores.key_signal: Verizon's broadband net adds hit a 10-year high at 437,000 and wireless service revenue grew 3% YoY, signaling steady demand expansion despite competitive pressures in mobility.
scores.name: Verizon Communications, Inc.

scores.name: WESCO International, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Walker & Dunlop is cutting full-year guidance with a severe downside scenario of -35% EPS decline as higher rates and constrained liquidity continue to suppress commercial real estate transaction volumes, with recovery timing deeply uncertain.
scores.name: Walker & Dunlop, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Workday posted 20% subscription revenue growth and built a healthy pipeline heading into FY2024, but acknowledged continued macro unpredictability that is creating deal scrutiny in the enterprise software market.
scores.name: Workday, Inc.

scores.name: WEC Energy Group, Inc.

scores.name: WEX, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Weatherford delivered 26% year-over-year revenue growth with 650bps of EBITDA margin expansion, signaling robust oilfield services demand particularly in international markets including Middle East and Latin America.

scores.name: Cactus, Inc.

scores.name: Westlake Corp.

scores.key_signal: WM's exceptional pricing power — with core price of 7.4% and transfer station yield hitting a record high of 8.9% — is the dominant macro signal, demonstrating strong cost pass-through capability in a defensive essential-services sector.
scores.name: Waste Management, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Williams posted ~20% adjusted EBITDA growth YoY with record gathering volumes and contracted transmission capacity, driven by acquisitions and accelerated project timelines, signaling strong near-term expansion in natural gas infrastructure demand.

scores.name: Warner Music Group Corp.

scores.name: Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Walmart delivered strong Q1 revenue growth with profit growing faster than sales (17.3%), but persistent high single-digit to low double-digit inflation in dry grocery and consumables is creating uncertainty for back-half discretionary spending and general merchandise demand.

scores.name: W.P. Carey, Inc.

scores.name: W.R. Berkley Corp.

scores.key_signal: Williams-Sonoma's demand trends deteriorated from negative mid-single-digits in Q4 to down 10% in Q1, with particular weakness in high-ticket furniture signaling continued consumer pullback in discretionary home furnishings spending.
scores.name: Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Watsco posted record Q1 revenue of $1.55B with sustained double-digit operating margins despite lapping a very tough prior-year comp, supported by strong pricing discipline and multiple regulatory tailwinds (efficiency standards, refrigerant transitions, IRA tax credits) that underpin a positive multi-year demand outlook for HVAC distribution.
scores.name: Watsco, Inc.

scores.key_signal: West Pharma's base business (ex-COVID) is growing high-teens organically, demonstrating robust underlying pharmaceutical packaging demand even as COVID-related revenues decline sharply (~$88M YoY headwind in Q1).
scores.name: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc.

scores.key_signal: WisdomTree posted its third-best quarter ever with $6.3B in net inflows and a 31% annualized organic flow growth rate, signaling strong and broad-based demand for asset management products across geographies and categories.
scores.name: WisdomTree, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Wintrust posted record net income in Q1 2023 despite regional banking turmoil, with stable deposits and a rising net interest margin of 3.83%, though accelerating deposit beta (~50% full cycle) signals mounting funding cost pressure ahead.
scores.name: Wintrust Financial Corp.

scores.key_signal: Essential Utilities maintained full-year EPS guidance of $1.85-$1.90 despite Q1 weather headwinds, supported by accelerating infrastructure investment ($243.7M vs $183M prior year) and a robust $380M municipal acquisition pipeline.
scores.name: Essential Utilities, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Watts Water delivered record Q1 sales and margins driven by pricing power, but flagged caution for H2 2023 due to rising interest rates, tightening lending conditions, and declining new residential construction permitting across multiple regions.
scores.name: Watts Water Technologies, Inc.

scores.name: Willis Towers Watson Plc

scores.key_signal: Western Union's digital business is showing early recovery signals with 11% US transaction growth and 21% new customer growth, but overall revenue declined 1% constant currency, suggesting a fragile and uneven macro recovery in cross-border remittances.

scores.key_signal: Woodward shows strong demand across aerospace and industrial end markets but supply chain and labor disruptions continue to constrain output, with ongoing supplier shortfalls and the company 'not out of the woods yet' on operational recovery.

scores.key_signal: Wood products pricing remains under significant pressure with lumber and OSB realizations declining sharply, though some stabilization and early Q2 price recovery offers a tentative positive signal for housing-linked demand.

scores.name: Wynn Resorts Ltd.

scores.name: Xenia Hotels & Resorts, Inc.

scores.name: Xylem, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Yelp posted record revenue of $312M (+13% YoY), beating guidance, with accelerating services ad revenue growth and strong pricing power (CPCs +14% YoY), signaling resilient SMB local advertising demand despite broader macro pressures.

scores.name: YETI Holdings, Inc.

scores.key_signal: CLEAR reported 46% revenue growth and 39% bookings growth with 1,250 basis points of operating leverage, signaling strong consumer demand for identity verification services and improving unit economics as the network scales.

scores.key_signal: Deposit outflows and rising funding costs are pressuring net interest income, though Zions added 7,000 net new accounts in late March suggesting core deposit franchise remains relatively durable amid regional banking stress.

scores.name: Zoetis, Inc.
